candidates.change_summary: Remove the `require(isAdmin[msg.sender])` access control, allowing anyone to change `winnersPerPeriod` to an arbitrary value.
Replace the assignment with a no-op (do nothing), so `winnersPerPeriod` is never updated.
Assign a constant fixed value instead of the parameter, so `winnersPerPeriod` always becomes 1 regardless of input.
Add 1 to the new value before assigning, so `winnersPerPeriod` becomes `newWinnersPerPeriodAmount + 1`.
Change the access control to allow only the owner, not admins, by replacing `isAdmin[msg.sender]` with `msg.sender == _ownerAddress`.
Insert `roundId += 1;` before the require check for winners already selected, so roundId increments even when pickWinner reverts, but if it succeeds roundId will be incremented twice.
Replace `roundId += 1;` with `roundId += 2;` so roundId increases by 2 instead of 1 after a successful pickWinner call.
Delete `roundId += 1;` so roundId never increments, remaining 0 after every successful pickWinner call.
Remove the line that subtracts fighterPoints from totalPoints, so totalPoints is not decreased when a winner is picked.
Insert an additional line that sets totalPoints to zero, causing totalPoints to always become 0 after pickWinner executes.
Replace the subtraction line with `totalPoints += fighterPoints[winners[i]]` so totalPoints increases instead of decreasing.
Replace `totalPoints -= fighterPoints[winners[i]]` with `totalPoints -= 1`, making the deduction a constant amount instead of the fighter's actual points.
